phase_name: Advisory Pilot Authorization Contract Freeze (PPA-001 v1.0)
summary: Transformed Phase 138E's Advisory Pilot Authorization Architecture into the normative Pilot Proposal & Authorization Protocol (PPA-001 v1.0), a decision layer sitting strictly upstream of, and additive to, GAC-001 section 6's already-frozen pilot-designation act. Froze a Pilot Proposal Contract (section 4: nine mandatory proposal components, a completeness gate, and reuse discipline against PGP-001/GAC-001 evidence categories). Froze an Eligibility Review Contract (section 5: excluded-class fast check, four mandatory review questions, objective-evidence requirement, rejection of implicit qualification). Froze an Authorization Review Contract (section 6: a five-step review sequence -- completeness, eligibility, governance review, readiness confirmation, authorization recommendation -- with no automatic approval). Froze a Decision Contract (section 7: five outcomes -- authorize planning / defer / reject / request additional evidence / suspend consideration -- each requiring explicit rationale, explicitly distinct from GAC-001 section 9's five Stage-6 outcomes). Froze a Risk Review Contract (section 8: governance, operational, evidence, bias, scope). Froze a Boundary Contract (section 9: approved scope, prohibited expansion, review checkpoints, termination conditions). Froze a Suspension Contract (section 10: suspension, withdrawal, and cancellation conditions with mandatory justification and evidence preservation). Froze a Governance Independence Contract (section 11: separating authorization authority from implementation, verification, pilot execution, and outcome assessment). Froze a Compatibility Contract (section 12), an Extensibility Contract (section 14), and a Traceability Contract (section 13, full matrix against Phase 138E and GLP-001/GAC-001/PGP-001). Every SHALL traced to Phase 138E, GLP-001, GAC-001, or PGP-001; no orphan obligation. No pilot was authorized, designated, or executed. No provision of GLP-001, GAC-001, or PGP-001 was modified. No production code touched. Runtime remained Observed / observe / unavailable throughout. See docs/contracts/PILOT_PROPOSAL_AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT.md.
